7357.title: Packaged bridge smoke inherits caller configuration
7357.rootCauseOneLine: The smoke launcher sets a temporary cwd and data directory but omits env, preserving caller HOME and provider config roots.
7357.proposedFix: Give each smoke bridge a temporary home and explicit provider config roots; test overrides and home fallback.
7357.caveats: Diagnostic and evidence are inline per reports policy. Real built bridges initialized in two clean trusted checkouts; no model/list or real provider config was used. No PR because packaging smoke-test isolation is outside the simple-fix scope.
